title: Later Skunk Works boss on Astra

tellings.quote: He said, "Oh, it hasn't flown yet."

plain: A writer on aviation named Nick Cook says that at a trade show, a man who later headed Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design division of the company Lockheed, talked to him about something called Astra. Cook says the man told him, "Oh, it hasn't flown yet," which Cook takes as a hint that a secret advanced aircraft was real and in the works.
